CAS_T|/catank/solution: Slab and walls in BETOCRETE concrete with {CL170}, {CP360} or {CP350} — tested for drinking water after DVGW W 270 and W 347; {CL210} where drinking water is not involved. The waterstop {CJ5} in the joint between slab and wall, inlets and outlets cast in. The crystals seal from the inside out and heal cracks up to 0.4 mm; there is no coating to renew. Technical drawing TD 5.10.03.
CAS_T|/cawall/name: Retaining wall, frost and de-icing salt
CAS_T|/cawall/problem: A retaining wall carries soil and seepage water on its back and frost, de-icing salt and traffic spray on its face: chlorides migrate to the reinforcement, carbonation advances, freeze–thaw opens the surface. A membrane on the soil side cannot be renewed without excavation.
CAS_T|/cawall/solution: The wall is cast in BETOCRETE concrete with {CL210} or {CP360}: the integrated sealant lowers the water absorption at once, the crystals follow wherever water arrives; reduced chloride ion migration and carbonation, improved freeze–thaw resistance — {CL210} shows the highest effectiveness in exposure class XS; {CP350} adds a corrosion inhibitor. The swelling tape {CJ6} on the working joints, the drainage behind the wall stays. Technical drawing TD 5.10.04.
PFP_T|/GBM/role: The standard primer of the system and the binder of its scratch coats and screeds: a low-viscosity two-component epoxy, transparent, rolled into the pores of dry concrete until the surface is sealed, sanded as the key for {B351}. Mixed 1 : 1 with quartz sand it is the levelling compound, with 8.3 parts of sand the epoxy screed or mortar of 5–150 mm. Part of the bonded waterproofing systems; tested on wet concrete after DIN EN 13578.

PFP_T|/SG2/sub: Special epoxy resin primer, oil and vapour barrier
PFP_T|/SG2/role: The primer for the floors nobody else can coat: oil-contaminated concrete cleaned with {R008}, concrete that is still matt damp, floors under vapour pressure or rising moisture. It bonds to damp concrete, displaces the water from the capillaries of the surface, blocks capillary-rising oil, vapour (sd > 100 m, class III) and negative pressing water up to 3 bar, and is radon tight by test. Light grey, so the coverage shows. Also the capillary-breaking joint filler of pool edges.

PFP_T|/SG3/sub: Epoxy resin barrier primer for damp substrates
PFP_T|/SG3/role: The barrier primer: solvent-free, low-viscosity, moisture compatible — for the young slab, the basement floor, the concrete that will not dry in time. Two coats block vapour and negative pressing water up to 3 bar and seal the pores; the second coat is sanded, and the floor is coated like any dry one. Also the binder of levelling compounds, scratch coats and epoxy mortars, and the substrate preparation under PVC, linoleum or carpet. Methane barrier by test.
